newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 29.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Foreign minister John Chang to visit South Africa to discuss diplomatic ties.
Taiwan investigates one former police officer as potential suspect in slaying of Taoyuan county magistrate, seven others.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to reconsider plans to provide economic aid for South Africa.
Banks, petrol stations, environmental protection agencies must follow labour law starting May 1, 1997.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Cabinet asks government agencies to sell stock holdings to alleviate budget deficit.
Tuntex Distinct Corp says it will follow government's lead in deciding to whether to go through with petrochemical project in South Africa.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Stock market falls following South Africa's decision to drop diplomatic ties with Taiwan.
Taiwan investments in South Africa will ease.
